# Local source reuse

The translation tools and native host were adapted from the sibling NFSV
project. Its NFSU2Recomp and nfsu2-web notices and provenance manifest are
retained here. The NFSU2Recomp-derived portions permit personal local use
and modification; redistribution requires permission under their license.

No EA game instructions or assets belong in this source tree. Game-derived
translation output is written under ignored gen, local and out directories.
The original game and community patch payloads are supplied or fetched at
build time and are excluded from version control.
